name: Bhanwar
overview: The gripping first episode of Bhanwar dives deep into the dark world of social media harassment and cyberbullying. Girls are being blackmailed with fake AI-generated videos, creating a digital nightmare. Asad Siddiqui plays an investigative journalist determined to uncover the truth and expose the perpetrators behind these malicious acts.  This drama explores the challenges, courage, and consequences of fighting online abuse.
